note: [L] carries this in YM.Source.TransferData.origin_unit, using the field unit_coord of Based. Sung.clocks supplies that field from Heard.unit, which the one-level step in Replay.lean re-establishes level by level. The difference is packaging: the induction is the Heard invariant carried through the construction, not an argument inside this proof.

snippet.text:
theorem origin_unit {A : Hol G} {C : SectionData F} (h : C.Sound A) (r : ℕ) (hb : T.Based A C r)
    (b : Site (H.S.side N p)) : T.cylinder C (unitVec F H r) b = 1 := by
  have he : T.terminal.symm (unitVec F H r) = unitVec F H N := calc
    _ = T.terminal.symm (T.terminal (unitVec F H N)) := congr_arg _
      (((hb.unit_coord r le_rfl hb.ref).symm).trans (hb.reads _))
    _ = _ := T.terminal.symm_apply_apply _
  rw [cylinder,he,initial,unitVec,map_smul,F.scaled_unit]
  funext U
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, SectionData.places, C.eval_linear.map_smul]
  simp [h.unit, (H.S.a_pos N).ne']

proof_context.conclusion: From unit_coord and reads, the inverse terminal map sends the reference unit to the level-N unit, and the inserted cylinder of the unit equals a_N^{-d} a_N^d = 1.

· change (Z (unitVec F H N)).x = _
    have hc := hI (unitVec F H N)
    rw [hq.unit,show F.core (unitVec F H (m+1))=0 by simp [unitVec,Size.unit_core]] at hc
    rw [show (Z (unitVec F H N)).x = T.leads L (unitVec F H (m+1)) from sub_eq_zero.mp (Work.G08.size_separates _ _ (by simpa [Frame.coeffSize] using hc))]
    change T.map (vowel F L _) = _
    rw [show vowel F L (unitVec F H (m+1)) = unitVec F H m from unit_vowel ..]; simp [unitVec,T.unit]

proof_context.conclusion: The one-level step sends the level-(m+1) unit to the level-m unit with zero nonconstant part (unit_vowel, T.unit), re-establishing Heard.unit.
